hints.title: Add position by position
hints.body: The heads hold the units digits, so the two chains are already aligned by place value. Walk both chains together and add the digits at the same position.

hints.title: Carry to the next position
hints.body: For each position, add the two digits plus any carry. The result digit is the total modulo 10, and the new carry is the total divided by 10.

hints.title: Handle unequal lengths and a final carry
hints.body: Continue while either chain still has a node or a carry remains. A final carry creates one extra node.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
dummy = new node
tail = dummy
carry = 0
while l1 is not empty or l2 is not empty or carry > 0:
    total = carry
    if l1: total += l1.value; l1 = l1.next
    if l2: total += l2.value; l2 = l2.next
    carry = total / 10
    tail.next = new node(total % 10)
    tail = tail.next
return dummy.next
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
